row.evidence: GitBook's pricing page says 'SAML SSO: not included in the Free, Premium, and Ultimate plans; included in the Enterprise plan', and its SSO & SAML docs describe only JIT account creation on first IdP login; no SCIM is documented.
row.notes: Unchanged from June: no SCIM on any tier. SAML SSO is Enterprise-only (custom pricing) and creates accounts just-in-time on first login; removing a user from the IdP blocks sign-in but does not remove the GitBook account. Premium $65/site/mo and Ultimate $249/site/mo billed annually, plus $12 per additional user/mo. Email-domain/Google SSO (not SAML) is on all plans. The REST API manages org members, invites, roles and teams; the audit-events API needs Enterprise. June's 'SAML with JIT on Enterprise' is confirmed.

citations.title: SSO & SAML
citations.quote: To add members, create accounts for them in your IdP. The first time a new member logs in to GitBook via the IdP, a GitBook account will be created for them via automatic IdP provisioning.

citations.title: SSO & SAML
citations.quote: Removing a member from the IdP will prevent the user from being able to sign in to the corresponding GitBook account, but will not remove the account from GitBook.
